summary.result: The system operability was evaluated with the hydrological data of WAMIS(Water Management Information System) with the government operation Web site as reference data.
summary.background: Watershed topographical information is required in hydrologic analysis, supporting efficient hydrologic model operation and managing water resources.
summary.method: Through this system, users can obtain a watershed boundary by selecting outlet location and then extracting topographical data including watershed area, boundary length, average altitude, slope distribution about the elevation range with Web browsers.
